Module com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship
Package com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship.model.Player

Class PlayerPerson

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship.model.Player.APlayer
com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship.model.Player.PlayerPerson
All Implemented Interfaces:
IPlayer, Serializable
public class PlayerPerson extends APlayer
Represents the human player in the Battleship game.

The PlayerPerson class extends APlayer and implements logic specific to the human player, such as manually setting the ship matrix based on their choices.

This class is serializable to allow saving and loading of game states.

Author:
Juan David Lopez V

    • setChosenMatrix

      public void setChosenMatrix(int[][] matrix)
      Description copied from interface: IPlayer
      Updates the ship placement matrix based on the player's chosen positions.

      This method copies the contents of a 2D integer array into the player's internal shipsMatrix, which represents the game board.

      Specified by:
      setChosenMatrix in interface IPlayer
      Overrides:
      setChosenMatrix in class APlayer
      Parameters:
      matrix - a 2D array of integers representing the player's chosen ship placements, where each value indicates whether a cell is empty or occupied by a ship.
